lazydfu:
LazyDFU is an optimization mod for Minecraft that defers unnecessary initialization work so that it is only performed if required. Specifically, it makes the initialization of DataFixerUpper "lazy" - that is, it will not immediately create the rules required to migrate data from older versions of Minecraft to newer versions until it actually needs to do so.

 This mod is for Fabric/Quilt 

 Compatibility

LazyDFU 0.1.2 is compatible with Minecraft 1.14 through 1.18.2, and works on the client and server side.

LazyDFU 0.1.3 is compatible with Minecraft 1.19 and above, however Mojang now implements the functionality LazyDFU provides on the server side. The client still initializes all DFU rules by default, so LazyDFU hooks into the native client functionality that enables DFU rule baking and turns it into a no-op.

replay-fps:
Replay FPS

 Which should really be called "Replay FPV" but I was thinking of first-person shooters at the time 

 About

The Replay Mod is a popular modification for Minecraft: Java Edition which allows you to capture gameplay for subsequent playback. While the Replay Mod is very powerful, it's severely lacking when it comes to first-person gameplay.

By default, when you render a replay from the first-person perspective of a player, the view appears extremely sluggish. This is due to the fact that Minecraft only properly updates player positions 10 times per second, so the game must interpolate the missing data.

This addon aims to fix this.

By storing client-side camera data alongside the primary replay data, the movements of the local client can be captured in greater detail, leading to a much better first-person playback experience.

This mod fixes MC-121278, making Ctrl + A (select all) and other keyboard shortcuts work on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts, such as AZERTY.

 Q&A

 What shortcuts are supported?

This mod does not add shortcuts. It makes the shortcuts that are already supported by Minecraft work on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts. Those shortcuts are:
- Select all ( Ctrl + A ),
- Copy ( Ctrl + C ),
- Paste ( Ctrl + V ),
- Cut ( Ctrl + X ),
- All debug combinations. 1 

 How does it work?

By implementing the fix that is suggested on the bug report for MC-121278. That is, testing for the key name instead of its location on the keyboard.

nexus-layer:
Nexus Layer is a library mod and compatibility layer made to ensure functions between my mods stay compatible with eachother. Alone, it is not meant to add any function without a seperate mod or command activating its function.

When used in tandem with my other mods, Nexus Layer primarily adds status effects such as Singed, Malignant, and Scalded, all with entity tags to customize immunity.

It's also used to group modded and unmodded items into tags, in order to detect them if I ever need to use them in the future. This allows for datapacks to be made to bridge compatibility gaps between other mods and my own.

Nexus Layer requires Geckolib in order for certain functions to work.

Nexus层是一个库模组和兼容性层，用于确保我的模组之间的功能保持相互兼容。单独使用，它并不意味着在没有单独的模组或命令激活其功能的情况下添加任何功能。 当与我的其他模组一起使用时，Nexus Layer主要添加了状态效果，如烧焦、恶性和烫伤，所有这些都带有实体标签来自定义免疫。 它还用于将修改过的和未修改过的项目分组到标签中，以便在将来需要使用它们时检测到它们。这允许制作数据包来弥合其他模组和我自己的模组之间的兼容性差距。 Nexus层需要Geckolib才能使某些功能正常工作。

This mod allows you to define registry entry aliases, by exposing Fabric API's registry alias
system in simple, config-driven way.

It supports both static (blocks, items, etc.) and dynamic (biomes, enchantments, etc.) registries.

 Configuration.
All alias definitions are stored in ./config/registry aliases/ as a json map.
For vanilla registries, the file should be named as .json ,
so for example item registry aliases will be located it item.json , block as block.json , 
biomes at worldgen/biome.json ( worldgen is a folder) and so on.

For modded registries (through it also works in vanilla), the file should be named / .json ,
for example for registry magic mod:spells the name is magic mod/spells.json .

The file itself is just a json map, with keys being the original entry id and value being the replacement.
For example, a file at ./config/registry aliases/item.

Ranged Pumps is a simple mod that adds a pump that pumps liquids in a range.

 

 Placement

Place the pump down, and it'll only work without a redstone signal.

 Redstone signal

If you give the pump a redstone signal, it will stop working until you disable the redstone signal.

 Energy requirements

By default, the pump requires Forge Energy, but can be configured to not use energy in the config.

 Internal tank

The size of the pump's internal tank is 32 buckets by default. You can increase or decrease this in the config.

The pump will stop running if the internal tank is full.

 Status updates

Right click on the pump to know what it is doing and to know if it is running.

 Scanning and range

 

It'll start pumping liquids in rectangular spiral shape 1 block under the pump.

The default range is 64 blocks. That'll mean it scan 64 blocks in any direction, nearest-first.

SQLib is the easiest way to store data for all your minecraft needs! A simple sql wrapper made with a focus on minecraft use cases.

 Important Note:
This library is not a full-fledged sql wrapper, and does not provide full access to many sql features.

mod-viewer:
Mod Viewer

 
 
 

Adds a server-side user interface for viewing loaded mods to Minecraft.

Mod Viewer requires the Fabric modloader and Fabric API.

 Installation

1. Install Fabric API if it is not installed.
2. Download Mod Viewer from CurseForge or GitHub.
3. Place the downloaded file in your mods folder.

 Usage

When this mod is installed, permitted players will be able to use the /modviewer command to display the mod viewer user interface. This interface will show a paginated list of mods to select from. Information about the selected mod will be shown, including the mod's name, description, authors, and dependencies.

 Permissions

By default, the /modviewer command is available to level two operators. If a permission mod that supports permission keys is installed, then the modviewer.command permission key controls availability instead.

gpu-servers:
GPUmod - GPU Server Acceleration for Minecraft

This is a server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that offloads heavy server computations to your GPU using OpenCL. No client mod needed.

What it does:

The mod takes different server tasks that normally run on your CPU one at a time and runs them in parallel on your GPU instead.

TERRAIN GENERATION - When new chunks are created, the GPU generates the terrain heightmap using multi-layer Perlin noise. It creates continents, hills, mountains, and valleys all computed in parallel on the GPU. The CPU then fills in the actual blocks based on the heightmap.

LIGHTING - When chunks need lighting calculated, the GPU runs iterative light propagation for both block light (torches, glowstone) and sky light. It uses double-buffered propagation that converges in up to 15 iterations, processing all 4096 blocks in a section simultaneously.

Immersive Engineering's HV wires top out at short distances — you end up placing relays every 32 blocks. Alternating Flux (AF) fixes that:

 Offline Daylight Stop is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1

 Features

Offline Daylight Stop pauses Minecraft's Daylight cycle while there are no players on the server.

Modset Policy Enforcement (MPE)

Ensure fair play on your Minecraft Fabric server with Modset Policy Enforcement (MPE) . This mod introduces a new, advanced technique to detect cheaters, providing robust protection against unauthorized modifications.

 Key Features

 Client and Server Side Protection

The mod must be installed on both the client and server, ensuring consistent and reliable detection.

 Mod Verification

Upon connection, the server verifies if the client has the MPE mod installed. Clients without the mod are automatically rejected.

 Mod Scanning

The client sends a list of all active mods to the server when connecting.

 Banned Mods Enforcement and Config

The server checks the list of client mods against a configurable banned mods list and prevents connections if any prohibited mods are detected.

What it does

In vanilla Tensura: Reincarnated, upgrading your Kiln to Mithril or Orichalcum only increases the molten storage capacity — the actual melting speed is identical across all three tiers. This mod fixes that.

Each kiln tier now multiplies the per-tick melting progress, so higher-tier kilns finish recipes faster:

 Kiln tier Default multiplier Configurable range 
 ------------- -------------------- -------------------- 
 Normal 1× (unchanged) 1 – 100 
 Mithril 4× 1 – 100 
 Orichalcum 8× 1 – 100 

 Configuration

On first launch the mod writes config/tensura kiln boost-common.toml :

​ toml
[speed]
 normalMultiplier = 1
 mithrilMultiplier = 4
 orichalcumMultiplier = 8
​ 

 How it works

The mod ships a Mixin into Tensura's KilnBlockEntity , modifying the two meltingProgress increment constants in the melting tick to be scaled by the kiln tier.

 Requirements

WynnConfig Sync
 Automatically renames a shared Wynntils config file to your own UUID on launch, no manual renaming needed. 

 What does it do?
Wynntils names its config files after your UUID. When you share your config with a friend, the file has your UUID in the name, meaning Wynntils won't recognize it on their end. Instead of asking them to find their own UUID and rename the file manually, they just install this mod and it handles everything automatically. This is especially useful in modpacks for creating config presets.

 How to use

1. Share your Wynntils config file with your friend
2. They drop it into their wynntils/config/ folder
3. They open config/wynnconfig-sync.json and paste the UUID of the sender into the source uuid field 
4. They launch the game, the mod renames the file to the users UUID automatically

 Launcher compatibility
Works with any launcher including Prism, M

它提供可放置在車站月台上的 TIDS 顯示器模型，能透過 JSON 時刻表顯示車次、目的地、經由路線、列車種別、開車時間與停靠月台等資訊。

本追加包適合用於台灣風格車站、RTM 鐵路地圖、月台場景與自訂運轉展示。

 主要特色

- 台鐵風格月台列車資訊顯示器模型
- 支援大型、小型、左右方向與雙面顯示版本
- 可顯示車次、目的地、路線、列車種別、時間與停靠月台
- 支援即時時間或 Minecraft 遊戲內時間
- 透過指令方塊設定顯示器參數
- 透過外部 JSON 檔案管理時刻表
- 內附 timetable editor.html 視覺化時刻表編輯器
- 編輯器支援繁體中文、簡體中文、日文與英文
- 支援匯入、下載 JSON、複製 setting、手動拖曳排序與自動排序

 基本使用方式

1. 將本追加包安裝到你的 mods 資料夾環境中。
2. 在遊戲中放置 TIDS 顯示器。
3. 在 TIDS 正下方同一直線、32 格範圍內放置指令方塊。

5. 將時刻表 JSON 放到 filePath 指定的位置。
6. 在 HTML 編輯器中按下「複製 setting」。
7. 將 setting JSON 貼到指令方塊內。

CustomPerm lets a server hand out single commands to players who are not operators: /gamemode to builders, /tp to moderators, nothing more. Grades, aliases, rate limits and a full in-game interface, with or without LuckPerms. 
 Permissions, command by command. 
 

 
 
 
 One command, one node: expose any vanilla or modded command, grant customperm.command.<name> . 
 Grades: group players and give each grade its ALLOW and DENY nodes. 
 Player nodes: one exception for one player, without inventing a grade. 
 Restrictable ops: an explicit DENY binds operators too: an accidental op opens nothing. 
 Gate everything: optionally, every command follows its node, ops included. 
 Works alone: no LuckPerms needed: grades live in readable JSON files, reloaded live. 
 

 
 
 
 Aliases: turn several commands into one, like /spawn or /kit , with its own node. 
 Arguments: /heal <player&gt

Progressive Time Difficulty (PTD) - v1.1.7

 Overview 

Progressive Time Difficulty transforms the conventional survival experience into a dynamic challenge. Unlike other mods that apply global difficulty spikes, PTD scales based on each user's actual progress. The difficulty is calculated by combining the world's age with the specific playtime of nearby players.

This allows veterans to face a brutal challenge without preventing new players from joining the server and progressing at their own pace.

Chunck Protector

Chunck Protector is a server-side only Fabric mod that protects chunk-based territories with per-area flags. It runs entirely on the server, so players join with a vanilla client and need no mods installed. There are no dependencies besides Fabric Loader (no Fabric API required).

How it works: an administrator selects chunks with an in-game tool, creates a named protected area from the selection, and then toggles protection flags either from an in-game chest GUI or with commands. Every flag is enforced on the server the moment the matching event touches a protected chunk: block edits, PvP hits, explosions, projectiles, ender pearls, liquid flow, fire spread, flight, mob spawning, and more.

 Supported versions

fixed-explosions:
Fixed Explosion

Fixed Explosion is a server-side Fabric mod that improves Minecraft explosions while keeping them vanilla-looking.
The mod is built around one simple idea: TNT should be able to carry explosion data like entities already do, and large TNT setups should explode in a cleaner, smarter, more optimized way.
Fixed Explosion optimizes TNT chain reactions by merging connected or nearby TNT into fewer stronger explosions instead of forcing Minecraft to process every TNT as a separate blast. This helps large TNT builds, TNT lines, towers, traps, and modded super TNT behave more naturally while reducing unnecessary lag.
It also improves large explosions by smoothing crater generation, reducing useless item drops near the blast center, cleaning nearby item entities, supporting liquid behavior options, and preventing very large explosions from breaking into ugly or useless shapes.

livestock-loyalty:
Livestock Loyalty

Introduces a simple ownership system for farm animals based on feeding history.

 Mechanics

When a player feeds wheat, seeds, carrots, or other breeding items to cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, or rabbits, that animal becomes bonded to them. Bonded animals display heart particles only for their owner and will refuse breeding items from other players entirely.

Bonded livestock will slowly walk toward their owner when the owner is within 16 blocks and holding the appropriate food item, making herding significantly easier.

 Ownership Transfer

Animals can be transferred to another player using the command /trigger GiveAnimal while looking at a bonded creature and having another player nearby. Ownership transfers to the nearest player within 5 blocks.

 Technical Details

- Uses scoreboards to track owner UUIDs
- Requires no permissions beyond the trigger command being ena

PermaEfe is a challenging datapack for Minecraft that takes the Minecraft Vanilla gameplay experience to a whole new level of difficulty.  Progressive Difficulty:

---

 

 

Animated Items aims to deliver animations to otherwise completely 
static items and blocks throughout the game.

 

 History
 

 Animated Items In it's inception was nothing more than a learning journey for me as I learned how to make resourcepacks for Minecraft . 

As I began my learning journey, I was becoming comfortable enough to share what I had made with the world, so I began uploading my resourcepack to Curseforge and Planet Minecraft on March 17th 2020. 

I was mesmorised by how you could customize any part of the game, and so as I learned how to do the all so many things of resourcepacks, I began adding them and publically releasing them into Animated Items , though they never made sense. 

Eventually I removed these features because Animated Items is a resourcepack about animations, so I took away the bells and whistles, and prioritized the theme of animation. 

Sinc

This pack is for users who want to build realistic bridges in Minecraft for trains. The pack features catenaries (overhead wires) and pillars for the bridges.

Please note:
- The pack requires the Minecraft Transit Railway mod version MTR4 to run
- These bridges spawn as a train and you can select and duplicate segments 
- There are 4 varients of the segments (default, pillar, catenary, pillar + catenary) with A + B varients for left side and right side
- 2 additional varients of segments are included for curves to avoid issues with turn radii
- If you use pillars on curves with different radii, please only use segments without pillars and place another track for the pillar only segment in between the 2 existing tracks for the bridge
- The catenary height is placed at 5 blocks
- Siding rails cannot overlap, place the nodes one block behind the other to minimise offset

sktrace:
Find out where your server's Skript time actually goes

skTrace is a profiler built for Skript. It measures your triggers, functions, events, loops and
variable writes while the server runs, then turns that into an interactive HTML report you can open
in a browser or share with one link.

 /sktrace start , let the lag happen, /sktrace report . You get a link.

 

Server timings tell you Skript is expensive. They do not tell you which script , which trigger ,
or which line . skTrace does, because it hooks Skript's own trigger graph rather than sampling the
JVM from outside.

 Inside a report: 

 Per-trigger timing. Calls, total, average and worst single call for every trigger, sorted so
 the expensive ones are at the top.
 Per-function timing. Functions get their own table, so cost hidden inside whatever called
 them stops being invisible.
 Line-level hotspots. Optional, off by default. T

SecureJoin
SecureJoin adds a security layer to your Minecraft server by requiring players to enter a password before fully joining. Perfect for small communities, or private servers. SecureJoin helps prevent account hijacking and unauthorized access.

Utilizes Minecraft 1.21.6's dialogs for a better UI/UX design.

 Features
- Server-wide password protection
- Per-user account passwords
- IP-based session remembering ("Remember this device")
- Lockout system after too many failed attempts (optional)
- Server isolation before authentication
- Admin tools to reset user passwords

 Commands
- /setserverpassword - Opens a dialog to set the server's password, and configure lockout options.
- /setuserpassword - Opens a dialog to set your own account password
- /resetuserpassword - Resets the player's password, and requires them to set a new one on the next login.

 Credits:
All Plugin Developme
